source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 8 (PDF 167-188), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Chemical Equilibrium) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are macroscopic events? Give two examples.
(Macroscopic events kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Macroscopic events woh waqiyat hain jo nangi aankh se dekhe ja sakte hain, alag alag particles ya molecules ko dekhe baghair. Misalein: rang ki tabdeeli, precipitate (tehshain) ka banna, gas ka nikalna.

book_ref.quote: phenomena that can be observed with the naked eye without considering the individual particles

blocks.prompt:
2 What are microscopic events? Give two examples.
(Microscopic events kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Microscopic events woh waqiyat hain jo nangi aankh se nahi dekhe ja sakte. Misalein: molecules ka takrana, bonds ka tootna aur banna, atoms ki nayi tarteeb, electrons ka kho dena ya hasil karna.

book_ref.quote: Microscopic events refer to the phenomena that cannot be observed with the naked eye.

blocks.prompt:
3 Differentiate between macroscopic and microscopic events.
(Macroscopic aur microscopic events mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono qisam ke events ka muqabla neeche diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: The collisions between molecules, breaking and forming bonds, rearrangement of atoms

rows: Nangi aankh se dekhe ja sakte hain.
Nangi aankh se nahi dekhe ja sakte.
Alag alag particles ko nahi dekha jata.
Alag alag particles aur molecules se mutalliq hain.
Maslan rang badalna, gas nikalna, volume ya pressure badalna.
Maslan molecules ka takrana, bonds ka tootna aur banna, electrons ka lena dena.
Bohat se aik saath hone wale microscopic events ka nateeja hain.
Mil kar macroscopic tabdeeliyon ki shakal mein nazar aate hain.

blocks.prompt:
4 Differentiate between reversible and irreversible reactions.
(Reversible aur irreversible reactions mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono qisam ke reactions ka muqabla neeche diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: The reactions in which the reactants are completely consumed and converted into products are called irreversible reactions.

rows: Reactants poori tarah kharch ho kar products ban jate hain.
Reaction dono taraf, forward aur reverse, chalta rehta hai.
Limiting reactant khatam hone par ruk jate hain.
Kabhi nahi rukte; chemical equilibrium tak pohanchte hain.
Aik arrow (→) se likhe jate hain.
Double arrow (⇌) se likhe jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
5 What happens to the amounts of substances when a reversible reaction takes place in a closed container until it reaches equilibrium?
(Jab band bartan mein reversible reaction equilibrium tak chalta hai to substances ki miqdaar ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Components ki miqdaar badalti hai, kuch kharch hote hain aur kuch bante hain. Aakhir mein chemical equilibrium par reactants aur products ki concentrations constant ho jati hain aur forward aur reverse rates barabar ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: the quantities of these components change as some are consumed and others are formed

blocks.text: 8.2 Reversible reactions, microscopic events and dynamic equilibrium

blocks.prompt:
6 Why does the forward reaction between steam and carbon monoxide have its maximum rate at the beginning?
(Steam aur carbon monoxide ke darmiyan forward reaction ka rate shuru mein sab se zyada kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shuru mein sirf H₂O aur CO apni sab se zyada concentration mein hote hain, is liye un ke darmiyan har second takraon ki tadad sab se zyada hoti hai. CO aur H₂O ke bonds sab se tez rate se toot kar H₂ aur CO₂ bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, the forward reaction has its maximum rate at the beginning.

blocks.prompt:
7 Why does the rate of the reverse reaction increase with time in the reaction of steam with CO?
(Steam aur CO ke reaction mein reverse reaction ka rate waqt ke saath kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jaise jaise H₂ aur CO₂ jama hoti hain un ki concentration barhti hai, is liye un ke darmiyan har second zyada takrao hote hain. H₂ aur CO₂ ke bonds toot kar CO aur H₂O tezi se bante hain, yahan tak ke reverse rate forward rate ke barabar ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: As the molecules of H₂ and CO₂ accumulate, the reverse reaction also starts.

blocks.prompt:
8 What three possibilities for A ⇌ B at equilibrium are shown by the concentration-time graphs of Figure 8.1?
(Figure 8.1 ke concentration-time graphs A ⇌ B ke equilibrium par kaun si teen soorten dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: (a) Reactant = product; (b) reactant < product; (c) reactant > product. Har soorat mein equilibrium ke baad concentrations constant ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: The graphs in the figure show different possibilities after the equilibrium is established.

blocks.prompt:
9 Will the concentrations in an equilibrium mixture of H₂O, CO, H₂ and CO₂ change later? Give a reason.
(Kya H₂O, CO, H₂ aur CO₂ ke equilibrium mixture ki concentrations baad mein badlengi? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Jab dono reactions barabar rate se chalein to concentrations constant ho jati hain; jab tak system ko bigara na jaye, concentrations mein mazeed tabdeeli nahi aati.

book_ref.quote: Unless the system is somehow disturbed, no further changes in the concentrations will occur.

blocks.text: 8.3 Relation between macroscopic and microscopic events

blocks.prompt:
10 How are macroscopic events related to microscopic events in an equilibrium system?
(Equilibrium system mein macroscopic events ka microscopic events se kya taaluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Macroscopic events bohat se aik saath hone wale microscopic events ka nateeja hain. Microscopic events (takrao, bonds banna) ko samajhne se nazar aane wali macroscopic tabdeeliyon ki wazahat aur pesh goi hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Macroscopic events are the result of multiple simultaneous microscopic events.

blocks.prompt:
11 Which microscopic events explain the observed changes in an equilibrium, and what affects them?
(Kaun se microscopic events equilibrium mein tabdeeliyon ki wazahat karte hain, aur un par kya asar daalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Particles ke darmiyan takrao aur naye bonds ka banna in tabdeeliyon ki wazahat karte hain. Yeh takrao forward aur reverse rates badalte hain, jo activation energy aur bahari factors se mutassir hote hain.

book_ref.quote: the microscopic events that explain the observed changes in equilibrium are the collisions

blocks.prompt:
12 Define evaporation and condensation.
(Evaporation aur condensation ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Evaporation (bukharat): surface ke qareeb kaafi energy wale liquid molecules ka gas phase mein nikal jana. Condensation (takseef): vapour molecules ka liquid surface se takra kar dobara liquid mein qaid ho jana.

book_ref.quote: When a liquid is placed in a closed container, some of the liquid molecules near the surface have enough energy

blocks.prompt:
13 Why does the vapour pressure of a liquid in a closed container become constant after some time?
(Band bartan mein liquid ka vapour pressure kuch der baad constant kyun ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Evaporation aur condensation ke rates barabar ho jate hain aur dynamic equilibrium ban jata hai. Liquid chhorne wale aur wapas aane wale molecules ki tadad barabar hoti hai, is liye us temperature par vapour pressure constant rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: At dynamic equilibrium, the vapor pressure remains constant at a given temperature

blocks.prompt:
14 What is the effect of raising the temperature on the liquid-vapour equilibrium?
(Liquid-vapour equilibrium par temperature barhane ka kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molecules ki average kinetic energy barhti hai, evaporation tez hoti hai aur vapour pressure barhta hai; condensation bhi tez hoti hai. Naya dynamic equilibrium zyada vapour pressure par banta hai.

book_ref.quote: As the temperature increases, the average kinetic energy of the liquid molecules also increases.

blocks.text: 8.4 Dynamic equilibrium between two physical states

blocks.prompt:
15 Define dynamic equilibrium in a reversible process.
(Reversible process mein dynamic equilibrium ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dynamic equilibrium reversible process ki woh haalat hai jahan aik taraf tabdeeli ka rate doosri taraf ke rate ke barabar hota hai. Tabdeeliyan jaari rehti hain lekin poore system mein koi net tabdeeli nazar nahi aati.

book_ref.quote: Dynamic equilibrium is a state in a reversible process where the rate of change in one direction is equal

blocks.prompt:
16 Give an example of dynamic equilibrium between two physical states and explain it.
(Do physical haalaton ke darmiyan dynamic equilibrium ki misaal de kar wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: 0 °C par barf aur pani aik saath equilibrium mein rehte hain: ice ⇌ water. Pani barf banta hai aur barf pani, dono barabar rate se, is liye barf aur pani ki miqdaar constant rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: Water changes into ice whereas ice converts back into water at the same rate.

blocks.prompt:
17 Why can chemical equilibrium not be established in an open vessel?
(Khule bartan mein chemical equilibrium kyun qaim nahi ho sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Khule bartan mein gaseous reactant ya product nikal jata hai, is liye reverse (ya forward) reaction doosre ka muqabla jaari nahi rakh sakta. Equilibrium ke liye band bartan chahiye jis se koi reactant ya product bahar na nikle.

book_ref.quote: No part of the reactants and products is allowed to escape out.

blocks.prompt:
18 Can an irreversible reaction reach a state of equilibrium? Explain.
(Kya irreversible reaction equilibrium ki haalat tak pohanch sakta hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Equilibrium ki haalat sirf reversible reactions par laagu hoti hai. Irreversible reaction limiting reactant khatam hone tak chalta hai; us ka muqabla karne wala koi reverse reaction nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: The state of equilibrium only applies to reversible reactions.

blocks.prompt:
19 What is meant by saying that equilibrium can be approached from either side?
(Is baat ka kya matlab hai ke equilibrium tak dono taraf se pohancha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chahe hum reactants se shuru karein ya products se, equilibrium ki wohi haalat hasil hoti hai. Maslan H₂O + CO se ya H₂ + CO₂ se shuru karne par aik jaise halaat mein aik hi equilibrium mixture banta hai.

book_ref.quote: can be approached from either side whether we start with reactants or products

blocks.prompt:
20 Does the value of the equilibrium constant depend on the initial concentrations? What does it depend on?
(Kya equilibrium constant ki qeemat shuru ki concentrations par munhasir hai? Yeh kis par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Equilibrium constant ki qeemat reactants ki shuru ki concentrations par munhasir nahi; yeh reaction ke liye constant hai aur sirf temperature par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: The value of equilibrium constant does not depend upon the initial concentrations of reactants

blocks.prompt:
21 Why are pure solids and pure liquids not included in an equilibrium constant expression? Write Kc for CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g).
(Khalis solids aur liquids equilibrium constant expression mein kyun shamil nahi kiye jate? CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g) ka Kc likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Khalis solid ya liquid ki miqdaar badalne se equilibrium constant par koi asar nahi parta, is liye un ki concentrations nikal di jati hain. CaCO₃ ke liye: Kc = [CO₂].

book_ref.quote: If pure solids or pure liquids are involved in an equilibrium system

blocks.prompt:
22 Define homogeneous equilibrium and give two examples.
(Homogeneous equilibrium ki definition likhein aur do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Woh equilibrium jis mein tamam reactants aur products aik hi phase mein hon. Misalein: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g); 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g).

book_ref.quote: An equilibrium system in which all of the reactants and products are in the same phase.

blocks.prompt:
23 Differentiate between homogeneous and heterogeneous equilibrium.
(Homogeneous aur heterogeneous equilibrium mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono qismon ka muqabla neeche diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: An equilibrium in which the reactants and products are in more than one phases

rows: Tamam reactants aur products aik hi phase mein.
Reactants aur products aik se zyada phases mein.
Maslan N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g)
Maslan CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g)
Maslan CH₃COOH(l) + C₂H₅OH(l) ⇌ CH₃COOC₂H₅(l) + H₂O(l)
Maslan 3Fe(s) + 4H₂O(g) ⇌ Fe₃O₄(s) + 4H₂(g)

blocks.prompt:
24 Write the equilibrium constant expression for 3Fe(s) + 4H₂O(g) ⇌ Fe₃O₄(s) + 4H₂(g).
(3Fe(s) + 4H₂O(g) ⇌ Fe₃O₄(s) + 4H₂(g) ka equilibrium constant expression likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Fe aur Fe₃O₄ khalis solids hain aur nikal diye jate hain, is liye Kc = [H₂]⁴/[H₂O]⁴. Gas ke moles barabar (4 aur 4) hone se units cancel ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: The following are examples of heterogeneous equilibrium:

blocks.prompt:
25 Is C(s) + H₂O(g) ⇌ CO(g) + H₂(g) homogeneous or heterogeneous? Write its Kc.
(C(s) + H₂O(g) ⇌ CO(g) + H₂(g) homogeneous hai ya heterogeneous? Is ka Kc likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh heterogeneous hai, kyun ke carbon solid hai jab ke baqi gases hain. Solid nikal kar: Kc = [CO][H₂]/[H₂O].

book_ref.quote: An equilibrium in which the reactants and products are in more than one phases

blocks.text: 8.8 Equilibrium constant and position of equilibrium

blocks.prompt:
26 What did Guldberg and Waage discover in 1864?
(Guldberg aur Waage ne 1864 mein kya daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi bhi reversible reaction ke liye products ki equilibrium concentrations ke hasil-e-zarb (coefficients ki power ke saath) ka reactants ke hasil-e-zarb se ratio diye gaye halaat mein hamesha constant hota hai.

book_ref.quote: They discovered that for any reversible reaction, the ratio of the product of the equilibrium concentrations

blocks.prompt:
27 State the law of mass action. What is meant by active mass?
(Law of mass action bayan karein. Active mass se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chemical reaction ka rate reactants ke active masses ke directly proportional hai, har aik par balanced equation ka coefficient power hota hai. Active mass se muraad molar concentration (mol dm⁻³) hai, jo square brackets [ ] se zahir hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The rate of the chemical reaction is directly proportional to the active masses of the reactants

blocks.prompt:
28 Show that Kc = kf/kr for the reaction A + B ⇌ C + D.
(Reaction A + B ⇌ C + D ke liye sabit karein ke Kc = kf/kr.)
blocks.explanation: Forward rate = kf[A][B]; reverse rate = kr[C][D]. Equilibrium par rates barabar: kf[A][B] = kr[C][D], is liye kf/kr = [C][D]/[A][B]. Do constants ka ratio bhi constant hai, Kc = kf/kr.

book_ref.quote: The left side of this equation is the ratio of two rate constants

blocks.prompt:
29 For a reversible reaction kf = 4.0 × 10⁻³ and kr = 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ (same units). Calculate Kc.
(Aik reversible reaction ke liye kf = 4.0 × 10⁻³ aur kr = 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ (aik jaisi units) hai. Kc nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: ‘kr’ is the proportionality constant and is known as reverse rate constant.

blocks.prompt:
30 Write the general equilibrium constant expression for aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD.
(aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD ke liye general equilibrium constant expression likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kc = [C]ᶜ[D]ᵈ / [A]ᵃ[B]ᵇ, jahan a, b, c aur d balanced equation ke coefficients hain aur [ ] equilibrium par molar concentration hai.

book_ref.quote: where a, b, c and d are the coefficients of balanced equation.

blocks.prompt:
31 In 500 cm³ of an esterification mixture at equilibrium there are 0.25 mol ethanoic acid, 0.10 mol ethanol, 0.15 mol ethyl ethanoate and 0.15 mol water. Calculate Kc.
(500 cm³ esterification mixture mein equilibrium par 0.25 mol ethanoic acid, 0.10 mol ethanol, 0.15 mol ethyl ethanoate aur 0.15 mol pani hai. Kc nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Concentrations (÷ 0.5 dm³): acid 0.50, ethanol 0.20, ester 0.30, pani 0.30 mol dm⁻³. Kc = (0.30 × 0.30)/(0.50 × 0.20) = 0.90; koi unit nahi.

book_ref.quote: Use this data to calculate a value of Kc for this reaction.

blocks.prompt:
32 Propanone (0.100 mol dm⁻³) and HCN (0.100 mol dm⁻³) are mixed; at equilibrium the product is 0.040 mol dm⁻³. Find Kc.
(Propanone (0.100 mol dm⁻³) aur HCN (0.100 mol dm⁻³) milaye gaye; equilibrium par product 0.040 mol dm⁻³ hai. Kc nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Equilibrium par har reactant = 0.100 − 0.040 = 0.060 mol dm⁻³. Kc = 0.040/(0.060 × 0.060) = 11.1 mol⁻¹ dm³.

book_ref.quote: A mixture of 0.0500 mol dm⁻³ propanone and 0.0500 mol dm⁻³ hydrogen cyanide is left to reach equilibrium

blocks.prompt:
33 Why does Kc for the formation of ethyl ethanoate have no units?
(Ethyl ethanoate banne ke Kc ki koi unit kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Balanced equation mein reactants aur products ke moles barabar (2 aur 2) hain. Kc = (mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³)/(mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³), is liye units cancel ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: The ester formation reaction happens in solution state, and number of moles of reactants and products are equal.

blocks.prompt:
34 Work out the units of Kc for the synthesis of ammonia.
(Ammonia synthesis ke Kc ki units nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Kc = [NH₃]²/[N₂][H₂]³ = (mol dm⁻³)²/(mol dm⁻³)⁴ = 1/(mol dm⁻³)² = mol⁻² dm⁶.

book_ref.quote: In the synthesis of NH₃ by Haber’s process, the units of reactants and products are not cancelled.

blocks.prompt:
35 Write Kc for 2N₂O₅(g) ⇌ 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g) and give its units.
(2N₂O₅(g) ⇌ 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g) ka Kc likhein aur us ki units batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Kc = [NO₂]⁴[O₂]/[N₂O₅]². Units = (mol dm⁻³)⁵/(mol dm⁻³)² = (mol dm⁻³)³ = mol³ dm⁻⁹.

book_ref.quote: When the number of moles are unequal, then value of equilibrium constant depend upon the units

blocks.prompt:
36 Name the four equilibrium constants of a reversible reaction and the quantity each one uses.
(Reversible reaction ke chaar equilibrium constants ke naam aur har aik mein istemal hone wali quantity batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Kc: molar concentrations (mol dm⁻³); Kp: gases ke partial pressures; Kn: moles ki tadad; Kx: mole fractions.

book_ref.quote: There are four different types of quantities which may be used to calculate the equilibrium constants

blocks.prompt:
37 Write the relation between Kp and Kc and explain each symbol.
(Kp aur Kc ka taaluq likhein aur har symbol ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn, jahan R = general gas constant, T = absolute temperature, aur Δn = balanced equation mein gaseous products ke moles − gaseous reactants ke moles.

book_ref.quote: Δn = Difference of number of moles of products and reactants in the balanced chemical equation

blocks.prompt:
38 Under what condition are Kp, Kc, Kx and Kn equal? Give an example.
(Kp, Kc, Kx aur Kn kis shart par barabar hote hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab balanced equation mein reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon to Δn = 0 aur Kp = Kc = Kx = Kn. Misaal: H₂O(g) + CO(g) ⇌ H₂(g) + CO₂(g) (2 mol → 2 mol).

book_ref.quote: Hence, whichever concentration units are used, the equilibrium constants are same.

blocks.prompt:
39 For 2N₂O₅(g) ⇌ 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g) at 500 K, is Kp greater or smaller than Kc? (R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
(500 K par 2N₂O₅(g) ⇌ 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g) ke liye Kp, Kc se bara hai ya chhota? (R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: It depends upon the value of ‘Δn’ that which of the equilibrium constants is bigger or smaller than the other.

blocks.prompt:
40 For 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g), Kc = 160 at 673 K. Calculate Kp. (R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
(2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g) ke liye 673 K par Kc = 160 hai. Kp nikalein. (R = 0.0821 dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: The formula for conversion of Kc to Kp is, Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn

blocks.prompt:
41 In N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g) at equilibrium the mole fractions are X(NO₂) = 0.50 and X(N₂O₄) = 0.50 at a total pressure of 3.0 atm. Find Kx and Kp.
(N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g) ke equilibrium par mole fractions X(NO₂) = 0.50 aur X(N₂O₄) = 0.50 hain, kul pressure 3.0 atm. Kx aur Kp nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: When the concentrations are expressed in terms of mole fractions, (X) then

blocks.prompt:
42 Write the relation between Kp and Kn and give the meaning of N and P.
(Kp aur Kn ka taaluq likhein aur N aur P ka matlab batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke har partial pressure p = (n/N) × P hai, is liye Kp = Kn(P/N)^Δn. N = reactants aur products ke kul moles; P = system ka pressure.

book_ref.quote: Each partial pressure is p = (n / N) × P, so equation (7) should be Kp = Kn (P/N)^Δn.

blocks.text: 8.10 Position of equilibrium and reaction conditions

blocks.prompt:
43 What is meant by the position of equilibrium? When do we say it has shifted to the right?
(Position of equilibrium se kya muraad hai? Hum kab kehte hain ke yeh daayen taraf khisak gayi?)
blocks.explanation: Position of equilibrium equilibrium mixture mein products aur reactants ki nisbati miqdaar hai. Agar products ki concentration reactants ke muqable mein barhe to position daayen taraf (products ki taraf) khisak gayi.

book_ref.quote: relative amounts of products and reactants present in an equilibrium mixture

blocks.prompt:
44 State Le Chatelier's principle.
(Le Chatelier's principle bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar equilibrium wala system bigara jaye to woh is tarah amal karta hai ke us disturbance ka asar khatam (nullify) ho jaye. Yeh batata hai ke system ko waqti tor par equilibrium se hataya jaye to kya hota hai.

book_ref.quote: If a system in equilibrium is disturbed, it behaves in such a way as to nullify the effect of that disturbance

blocks.prompt:
45 Name the factors whose effect on equilibrium is studied as applications of Le Chatelier's principle.
(Un factors ke naam likhein jin ka equilibrium par asar Le Chatelier's principle ki applications ke tor par parha jata hai.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Concentration ki tabdeeli; (ii) pressure ki tabdeeli; (iii) temperature ki tabdeeli; (iv) catalyst (jo equilibrium nahi khiskata).

book_ref.quote: Some of the most common applications of this principle with reference to certain physical

blocks.text: 8.12 The effect of a change of concentration

blocks.prompt:
46 Why does a solution of BiCl₃ become cloudy on adding water? Write the equation.
(BiCl₃ ke solution mein pani daalne se woh dhundla kyun ho jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: BiCl₃ pani se react kar ke safaid insoluble BiOCl banata hai jis se solution dhundla ho jata hai: BiCl₃ + H₂O ⇌ BiOCl + 2HCl.

book_ref.quote: When water is added in BiCl₃ solution, it becomes cloudy due to the formation of white precipitate of BiOCl.

blocks.prompt:
47 Write the correct Kc expression for the hydrolysis of BiCl₃ and give a reason for leaving out BiOCl.
(BiCl₃ hydrolysis ka sahi Kc expression likhein aur BiOCl ko nikalne ki wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Kc = [HCl]²/[BiCl₃][H₂O]. BiOCl insoluble solid hai; pure solid ki concentration constant rehti hai, is liye woh Kc mein nahi likha jata.

book_ref.quote: a pure solid is not included in the equilibrium constant expression, so [BiOCl] is left out

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein BiOCl ko bhi expression mein likha gaya tha, lekin solid ki concentration badalti nahi. Is liye sahi jawab [HCl]²/[BiCl₃][H₂O] hai.

blocks.prompt:
48 What is the effect of adding HCl to the equilibrium BiCl₃ + H₂O ⇌ BiOCl + 2HCl? Does Kc change?
(Equilibrium BiCl₃ + H₂O ⇌ BiOCl + 2HCl mein HCl daalne ka kya asar hai? Kya Kc badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: HCl (product) daalne se equilibrium bigarta hai; dobara qaim karne ke liye zyada BiCl₃ banta hai aur reaction reverse direction mein jata hai (safaid precipitate hal hota hai). Kc constant rehta hai; sirf position badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: BiOCl is a solid, so adding a little more BiOCl does not shift the equilibrium; only adding HCl does.

blocks.prompt:
49 What happens if HCl is removed from the BiCl₃ hydrolysis equilibrium?
(Agar BiCl₃ hydrolysis equilibrium se HCl nikal liya jaye to kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction kami poori karne ke liye forward direction mein jata hai aur zyada BiOCl aur HCl bante hain. Nayi equilibrium position banti hai; Kc constant rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Removing some solid BiOCl (while some remains) does not shift the equilibrium; only removing HCl does.

blocks.text: 8.13 The effect of a change in pressure or volume

blocks.prompt:
50 Give two cases in which a change of pressure has no effect on an equilibrium.
(Do aisi soorten batayein jin mein pressure ki tabdeeli ka equilibrium par koi asar nahi hota.)

51 Why does an increase in pressure increase the yield of ammonia?

blocks.explanation: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ mein forward reaction moles (4 → 2) aur is liye volume kam karta hai. Le Chatelier's principle se zyada pressure reaction ko aage khiskata hai, is liye zyada ammonia banti hai.

book_ref.quote: For the forward reaction, the number of moles and hence volume decreases.

blocks.explanation: Volume barhane se pressure kam hota hai, is liye reaction us taraf jata hai jo zyada volume gherti hai (zyada gas moles). Ammonia synthesis reverse direction mein khiskti hai aur kuch NH₃ toot jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Ammonia synthesis is shifted to the reverse direction.

blocks.explanation: 3 mol gaseous reactants se 2 mol gaseous product banta hai, is liye forward reaction volume kam karta hai. Pressure barhane se equilibrium daayen khiskta hai aur zyada SO₃ banti hai.

blocks.text: 8.14 The effect of a change in temperature

blocks.prompt:
54 Which factor changes the value of Kc, and how does it act on an exothermic reaction?
(Kaun sa factor Kc ki qeemat badalta hai, aur exothermic reaction par yeh kaise asar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Temperature hi woh wahid factor hai jo Kc badalta hai. Exothermic reaction mein temperature barhna reverse reaction ke haq mein hai (Kc kam hota hai) aur temperature kam karna forward reaction ke haq mein (Kc barhta hai).

book_ref.quote: Temperature is the only factor that also affects the value of equilibrium constant (Kc).

blocks.prompt:
55 Why is the production of SO₃ from SO₂ and O₂ not favoured at a higher temperature?
(SO₂ aur O₂ se SO₃ ki paidawar zyada temperature par kyun munasib nahi?)
blocks.explanation: 2SO₂ + O₂ ⇌ 2SO₃ exothermic hai (ΔH° = −198 kJ). Temperature barhna reverse reaction ke haq mein hai, is liye SO₃ aur Kc kam hote hain: Kc 298 K par 1 × 10²⁶ magar 1000 K par sirf 2.8 × 10² hai.

book_ref.quote: Kc for this reaction is 2.8 × 10² at 1000 K; whereas, at 298 K the value of Kc is 1 × 10²⁶.

blocks.prompt:
56 How does temperature affect the equilibrium N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g), ΔH° = +57.2 kJ?
(Temperature equilibrium N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g), ΔH° = +57.2 kJ, par kaise asar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction endothermic hai. Temperature barhne se yeh daayen khiskta hai: [NO₂] aur Kc barhte hain (Kc 273 K par 7.7 × 10⁻⁵, 373 K par 0.4). Temperature kam karne se yeh baayen khiskta hai.

book_ref.quote: Kc for this reaction is 7.7 × 10⁻⁵ at 273 K, whereas 0.4 at 373 K.

blocks.explanation: Dono soorten neeche muqable mein di gayi hain.

book_ref.quote: For an endothermic reaction, an increase in temperature (adding heat) favours the forward reaction.

blocks.explanation: 200 °C par yield achhi hai lekin rate bohat sust ho jata hai, is liye process ghair munafa bakhsh hai. Darmiyana 400 °C aur catalyst se achha rate milta hai; catalyst ke baghair wohi rate bohat zyada temperature mangta jo yield kam kar deta.
